summary: 10-foot wooden tower built 1937 west of Chelan by Austin Post; windstorm-damaged, rebuilt, gone by 1952; now private orchard land.

notes_for_editor: Build account is first-person, by Austin Post, reproduced on WillhiteWeb (the page credits 'by Austin Post' to a segment from My Forest Service Days). The windstorm and rebuild have no year in the account, so no event is dated for them. The Beeson visit is dated only as 'summer of 1937 or 1938' by Post. Official use is doubtful per Willhite, who cites no record. Do not confuse with the Chelan Butte lookout, a separate tower on the butte. Peakbagger.com returned 403 and was not used. No photos proposed; the page credits 'Austin Post photo' but no image URLs were recorded.
